truth: Binary Y; fixed per cell or any declared prior. Conditional onY correctness bits below are independent ofY; an actual report equalsY when correct and1-Y otherwise. All probabilities/floors refer to oracle correctness, not observable calibration without truth.
value: M1 is a declared binary two-level ancestral-copy model, not an identified causal explanation. In each cell draw mutually independent Bernoulli(p) ancestor and leaf correctness bits. A fixed named parent map assigns each leaf to one ancestor. Each member first copies its ancestor with probability c1; conditional on not doing so it copies its leaf with probability c2, otherwise draws a fresh Bernoulli(p). The exclusive masses are a=c1, b=(1-c1)c2, d=(1-c1)(1-c2), and conditional correctness is q_l=a A_parent(l)+b B_l+d p. Fixed named leaf weights and the existing prefix-floor allocation define independent conditional binomial counts; majority uses a fair tie. The finite latent threshold functional is not by itself a proved asymptotic limit. Off-diagonal convergence has a proposed conditional variance argument; diagonal transfer and model–implementation proof require new M1 evidence. Parent topology, latent joint law, priority and sampling profile belong to the model identity. Missing them is unmeasured, not a discovered cause. The three original research demands remain open.
